title: Despite Denial, Trump Was Told on Trip to China About Spying on Nvidia’s Jensen Huang
summary: Before Jensen Huang boarded Air Force One en route to Beijing, the president was reminded of intelligence showing that he was in a relationship with a woman believed to be a Chinese spy.
